Field Tip

The best time to knock doors is weekday evenings (5–8 PM) and Saturday mornings (10 AM–1 PM). Avoid Sunday mornings and dinner hour.

Opening line

"Hi, I'm [name] from [org]. We're talking with neighbors about [issue]. Do you have two minutes?"

Keep it honest, direct, and short. Don't pitch before you ask.
